The champions and the winners of the promotion play-offs could be promoted to the [[K League 1]]. The second, third and fourth-placed teams qualified for the promotion play-offs. On 24 April 2020, the K League Federation confirmed that they reduced the number of matchdays to 27.{{cite web|url=https://sports.v.daum.net/v/20200424151730286|script-title=ko:K리그 개막전, 5월8일 '불금' 전북-수원전 '전주성'서 무관중으로 열린다 |publisher=[[Sports Chosun]]|date=2020-04-24|access-date=2020-04-24|language=ko}} == Teams == === Team changes === The [[Asan]] government made new football club [[Chungnam Asan FC|Chungnam Asan]] to replace its former club [[Asan Mugunghwa]], which was dissolved before the season.{{cite news |url=https://www.cctoday.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=2016814 |script-title=ko:아산무궁화프로축구단, 결국 해체 수순 |lang=ko |publisher=Chungcheong Today |date=2019-08-07 |access-date=2024-01-13}}{{cite news |url=https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20191227088400007 |script-title=ko:K리그2 아산무궁화, 충남아산으로 새 출발…엠블럼도 교체 |lang=ko |publisher=[[Yonhap News Agency]] |date=2019-12-27 |access-date=2024-01-13}} '''Relegated from [[2019 K League 1|K League 1]]''' *[[Gyeongnam FC]] *[[Jeju United FC|Jeju United]] '''Promoted to [[2020 K League 1|K League 1]]''' *[[Gwangju FC]] *[[Busan IPark]] '''Newly joined''' *[[Chungnam Asan FC|Chungnam Asan]] '''Withdrawn''' *[[Asan Mugunghwa FC|Asan Mugunghwa]] === Locations === [[Hana Financial Group]] took over Daejeon Citizen, and renamed the team [[Daejeon Hana Citizen]]. {| class="wikitable" |- !
